summary: Login screen art: user's logo update wired in
author: pm
body:
The user updated working/classic_ui/hd/login_screen.png on 2026-11-25: the HELBREATH / THE HELDENIAN PROJECT logo is added (changed area art x 730-1319, y 174-291, measured by pixel diff; the plate strip and everything else are byte-identical in colour). The staged copy is replaced; the old one is archived at working/archive/interface/front_end/login_screen_2026-11-25.png (sha256 prefix 543a1046423aaf6d, matching the old staged file).

The logo ends at art y 291, above the login plate (art y 328), so no layout change is needed.

**Done when:** the login screen shows the logo in the client.

Source: user, 2026-11-25 ("I also updated the loginscreen", "Wire it in").
